recommendation: Keep this core audit commit as-is. If Clinical Genomics wants to revisit GenomicStudy.type codes, binding strength, or cardinality in the current specification surface, review and update the external CG incubator GenomicStudy artifact instead of this core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-37756 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 Clinical Genomics request to bind GenomicStudy.type to example terminology, add a new GenomicStudy type CodeSystem and ValueSet with example codes, and change GenomicStudy.type cardinality from 0..1 to 0..*.
initial_application: R5-era history shows the request was applied: commit 22b3211ce237e8e0eb325c0fb0d2e5575e4351e5 added GenomicStudy.type examples; commits 18ee6c39f4f0932d23db637b4c2a6856bcddad9f, 30ac4fe439bb241e007531f05b190e68aa6e132c, and ff8feaeccfc7bfc44ab1ae0bee226ca97d0f2351 added the CodeSystem, ValueSet, and example binding; commit 27084b322225fdd55a986565a0753e662208ddc1 changed the cardinality to 0..*; and later September 2022 commits updated the example code list/descriptions after Information Modeling review.
additional_context: The current core checkout still contains leftover source/genomicstudy files with the requested binding and cardinality, but source/fhir.ini has no active GenomicStudy entry and source/genomics.html links GenomicStudy to the HL7 CG incubator IG. The related terminology-binding issues FHIR-37757, FHIR-37758, and FHIR-37759, plus later QA issue FHIR-40585, were already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. Editing source/genomicstudy would not affect the current core build, and the historical core source already records the R5 application.
